Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - a Caucasian boy and an African American boy. The Caucasian student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the African American student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected on merit alone?
A. The Caucasian student
B. Can't be determined
C. The African American student
